semantic.justification: Represented native RTF import now carries current-model character decoration, links and paragraph indentation; complete upstream responsibilities remain unverified. RTF byte decoding now selects pinned SAL ASCII, ISO-8859 and KOI8 aggregates. UTF-8 code page 65001 now dispatches to the pinned SAL converter with its native malformed-input and BOM defaults. Uses OStringToOUString default flags and FLUSH, retaining private-use undefined-byte mapping and incomplete UTF-8 replacement. Routes RTF code page 932 through the source-owned SAL DBCS converter and tables. Routes RTF code pages 936, 949 and 950 through source-owned SAL DBCS tables and EUDC semantics. Dispatches RTF EUC-JP bytes through the source-owned ImplEUCJPToUnicode path. Dispatches RTF ISCII Devanagari bytes through a fresh source-owned converter context. Dispatches RTF code page 65000 through the pinned SAL UTF-7 converter. Dispatches RTF code pages 50220/50225 through pinned ISO-2022-JP/KR state machines. Uses the pinned SAL dummy converter for missing code pages instead of a browser TextDecoder.
